original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Forced-carry closure under changed gate frames for the complete two-writer single-donor helper-star absorption domain on the pinned PR1062 11,500-ADD word: omit one terminal star restoration and toggle one donor in each of two existing pre-first-read A writes of its centre. All 236 edges, 414 writer pairs and the complete 314 exact arbitrary-dirty completions (52 scalar-saving) are decided under arbitrary monotone reframing of gate frames with pinned start and final frames.
scope_change_reason: PR1194 covers fully restored semantic D; PR1868 supplies the twisted contract and single-writer absorption; PR1913 excludes the two-writer single-donor class at the unchanged gate frames and explicitly leaves changed gate frames/itineraries open; PR1937 solves the complete multi-donor linear system in two fixed-gate-frame modes. This package removes exactly one premise all four hold fixed: the gate frames. Shrinking below the original gate frames is granted (the most favorable reading of the open question), so the exclusion covers the whole reframing escape class.
bottleneck_link: A one-ADD scalar restoration saving is not a paid interface improvement. The obstruction shows the saving cannot be realized under any legal frame assignment, so the two-writer split route of the H2/K replacement question closes without a supplier bill.
stop_rule: Decide the complete 314-completion domain with the least forced frame assignment; stop when every exact completion has a rational leakage witness or an explicit legal reframing with a full paid bill; do not widen to multi-donor sets (PR1937's class) in this round.
evidence: CERTIFICATE.json: 227286 first-donor trials, 314 exact dirty completions (52 scalar-saving), all 661 columns replayed in both orientations, and forced-carry closure verdicts under arbitrary monotone reframing: all 52 scalar-saving completions and 260 of the 262 cost-increasing ones excluded, each with a rational leakage witness (a dirty target's forced carried span exceeds its pinned rank-7 t-perp final frame); the 2 closure-legal completions cost +1 ADD and are billed with paid histogram {1:1494, 2:1308, 3:46, 4:45, 5:103, 6:10, 7:18} (rank mass 5129). The PR1868 single-writer fixture stays legal at identical paid profile {1:1323, 2:1342, 3:79, 4:44, 5:102, 6:11, 7:19} and saves one ADD. Ten controls, including two that separate geometry legality from scalar boundary correctness.
